MEASURE ANY LAND, ANYWHERE
* Tap the map to outline a field, yard, lot, roof, or job site
* See area and perimeter the moment you close the shape
* Measure distance point to point or along a path
* Switch between standard, satellite, and hybrid map styles for clearer context
* Works anywhere in the world - no parcel database needed

BUILT FOR REAL JOBS
* Farmers & ranchers - size fields, pastures, and paddocks in acres
* Real estate & homeowners - check lot and yard size before a sale or project
* Landscaping & lawn care - quote work by square footage
* Fencing - measure perimeter in linear feet
* Roofing & solar - estimate roof and ground area
* Land buyers & hunters - size up a parcel or food plot out in the field

EVERY UNIT YOU NEED
Acres, square feet, square meters, hectares, miles, kilometers, and feet. Switch units in a tap and convert instantly.

SAVE, REVIEW & SHARE
* Save important places and measurements locally on your device
* Review coordinates and geometry details
* Create a drone-style aerial shot or flyover video of any area you measure
* Share a map, snapshot, or drone video with a client or crew

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
* No account required
* Location permission is optional
* Saved places and favorites stay on your device
* The app does not show owner names, title deed holders, or land registry ownership

WHY LANDMETER
Most land tools hide basic measuring behind a login or subscription. LandMeter lets you open the map and measure right away - fast, simple, and honest about what it is.

TURKEY PARCEL LOOKUP INCLUDED
In Turkey, LandMeter also includes cadastral parcel lookup where public source services provide coverage. In supported locations you can tap the map or search by parcel reference to view parcel boundary, area, perimeter, and related map context.

IMPORTANT
LandMeter is an independent measurement and map utility. It is not a government service, land registry, survey, engineering report, legal opinion, valuation tool, or official source for ownership or title. Measurements, coordinates, parcel boundaries, and map data are informational and may be approximate, incomplete, unavailable, delayed, or different from official records. Always verify important land, property, planning, construction, legal, safety, or purchase decisions with official sources and qualified professionals.

Petals is a private period tracker that keeps your data on your phone, ALWAYS. No internet needed. No account. No one can see your information, ever.

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR PHONE.

Most period apps send your personal health information to their servers. Petals doesn't. Everything you log stays on your iPhone. There are no Petals servers. Your cycle is yours, and only YOURS.

SWITCH FROM ANY APP IN SECONDS.

Already tracking in Apple Health, Flo, or Clue? Bring your full menstrual history into Petals in one tap. You can import your period dates, flow, spotting and symptoms data directly from Apple Health and add it to your Petals timeline. No manual re-entry, no starting from scratch. TRACK 52 SIGNALS. UNDERSTAND YOUR BODY.

- Period & flow: mark period days, log how heavy your flow is, blood colour, clots and spotting

- Lifestyle:  stress, sleep, travel, workouts, caffeine and more

- Well-being:  mood, energy, cravings, focus, self-care and more

For each signal, you can add details like how bad it is, where it hurts, and what time it happened. Nothing gets missed.

REMINDERS THAT STAY QUIET.
Many period apps send cringy tips and weird messages you never asked for. Petals doesn’t. You choose what to be reminded about:

- Upcoming period: get a period reminder on the first expected day or a few days before
- Late period: a gentle nudge if your period is later than expected
- Signal logging: a reminder to log how you feel

Pick the time. Pick how often. Turn any reminder off anytime. Reminders are free and work offline.

WRITE YOUR OWN NOTIFICATION MESSAGE.
Don’t want family, friends, or coworkers to see “period reminder” on your screen?  Write your own, like “My parcel is on the way”. Your lock screen shows only your words. Only you will know what it means.

PREDICTIONS THAT LEARN FROM YOU
Petals predicts your next period using your own cycle history; not an average from someone else's data. You can also set your own cycle length manually if you prefer. Your body, your rules.

SIMPLE TO USE. NOT OVERWHELMING
Petals is designed to be simple, not overwhelming. Pick the signals you're feeling, add the details, and you're done in under a minute. Clean design, no clutter.

FIND ANY LOG IN SECONDS.
Every signal you've ever logged is saved in a searchable list. Tap any entry to see the full details.  Next time your doctor asks about your symptoms, everything is right there on your phone.

BACK UP WHEN YOU WANT.
Upgrade to Premium to turn on automatic iCloud backup - your data goes to your personal iCloud, not ours. You can also save a backup file yourself and keep it anywhere you like.

Premium includes: automatic iCloud backup and manual export.

Log everything and use all reminders for free, forever.

Download Petals today. Track your cycle privately, in detail, on your own terms.

6812511258.description:
No Edits is a habit app for people who want to be on camera and have not managed to be consistent: future influencers, camera-shy creators, and anyone who keeps saying "I should post more" and then does not.

The trick is that you do not decide when to record. You set a schedule, and four times a day the camera opens on its own, counts down from three, and records a 15-second clip. You cannot stop it, redo it, or trim it. Four clips make one video. No edits.

WHY IT WORKS
- The schedule removes the hardest part: deciding to hit record. It is already decided.
- The clips land at set moments in your real day, so what you get is you, raw and in the moment, not a take you rehearsed ten times.
- You cannot redo a clip, so there is nothing to agonize over. You just show up again at the next time.
- Do it every day and the camera stops being scary. That is how people become the ones they watch.

HOW IT WORKS
- Pick your window: first recording, last recording, and the gap between clips. Nothing records outside it, so you are never woken up or interrupted at work.
- A reminder lands at each time. Tap it, the countdown runs, and the clip records itself. Flip, zoom, light and mic are one tap or one slide away.
- C1, C2, C3 and C4 land on their cards in your four colors. When the set is full, save it or share it before the next clip pushes C1 out.
- Want more? Tap a card and record now. Out late, or a day that got away from you? Instant set starts four clips from the next quarter hour, even off-hours, without touching your schedule.
- Watch it back. Tap a card to play the set from that clip, slide sideways to scrub, slide up and down for volume, hold for full screen. Turn the phone either way.

KEEP THE STREAK
- Day streak, best streak, clips this week, on-time percentage.
- A six-month heat map of every day you showed up.
- Perfect days, milestone runs, and a card that tells you when your next clip is.

NO EDITS PRO
- Auto captions, generated on your phone.
- Voice-over for the whole video or a single clip.
- 30-second, 1-minute and 2-minute clips.
- 4K recording and clean exports without the color bar.
- Save single clips to Photos.
- Challenges: a clip every 10 to 60 minutes for one, three or seven days.

EARN PRO BY SHOWING UP
Start with a free pass. Keep Pro for as long as you do not miss or skip a scheduled clip. Hold it for 90 days and it is yours for life.

YOUR CLIPS STAY ON YOUR PHONE
No account. No upload. Nothing leaves your phone unless you share it.

Questions or ideas: support@noedits.app

The free trial converts to a paid subscription unless cancelled before it ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple ID settings.

Panic attack right now? Open Pufflo and tap SOS. A soft, fluffy companion breathes with you, slowly, until the wave passes.

Pufflo is a self-help app for panic attacks and anxiety. It gives you something clear to do in the hardest minutes, and helps you understand panic in the calm ones.

WHEN PANIC HITS
• SOS in one tap from the home screen: breathe in for 4, out for 6, together with Pufflo.
• 5-4-3-2-1 grounding: notice what you see, touch and hear, and come back to the room.
• Comfort cards: short, steady words for the moment and for afterwards.
• Your trusted person and crisis help lines for 38 countries, one tap away.

CALM YOUR BODY
• Breathing exercises: long exhale, box breathing, 4-7-8, double inhale sigh, even five.
• Grounding guides: feet on the floor, cool water reset, body scan, muscle release.
• Calming games: pop a bubble on every slow breath out, trace a wave, squeeze and let go.

UNDERSTAND PANIC
• 14 short lessons on what a panic attack is, why the body does it and what loosens its grip. Every lesson lists its sources.
• Thought check: a simple CBT-style way to weigh a scary thought.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• A private journal of attacks, daily check-ins and thought checks.
• Insights: attacks per week, common triggers, intensity before and after.
• A PDF report you can show your doctor or therapist.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. Your journal stays on your iPhone and is not uploaded.

PUFFLO PRO
SOS, the journal, two breathing rhythms, 5-4-3-2-1, the Bubbles game, the first three lessons and part of the comfort cards are open to everyone. Pufflo Pro opens every breathing rhythm, grounding guide, game, lesson and comfort card, unlimited thought checks, 8-week insights and the PDF report. Pro is an auto-renewing weekly or yearly subscription, or a single lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. A subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

IMPORTANT
Pufflo offers self-help tools and general education. It is not a medical device and does not provide diagnosis, treatment or emergency care. If you are in danger, or your symptoms are new or severe, call your local emergency number or talk to a doctor.
